provenance.attribution: Recorded Antigravity / gemini-3.8-flash-high run; configured model, no provider-internal attestation.
provenance.sourceAccess: Fresh project-local authoring workspace with a brief, installed skills and Kiln tools.
provenance.humanIntervention: Maintainer supplied the brief and reviewed actual exports and uniform gallery posters. Final source bytes are preserved from the model export. Later maintainer revision (2026-11-12): flush-face fix by Claude Sonnet 5.5 via Claude Code, 1 part edit that separates coplanar faces; materials, names, hierarchy and animation are unchanged, and the source is no longer byte-identical to the model's export.
provenance.reviewFidelity: Actual GPU images inspected independently. A terminal module with deliberately ending cables. Pale cabin glazing and one completed visual refinement remain limitations; the run exhausted its tool-call budget.
provenance.poster: Archival GPU poster from the source before the 2026-11-12 flush-face fix. The original receipt is retained as historicalPosterReceipt; this image is not an exact-source render of the current program.

maintainerRevisions.description: Flush-face fix by Claude Sonnet 5.5 via Claude Code (2026-11-12). GantryCross_Rear and GantryCross_Front: boxGeo x width 0.18 -> 0.174 so each x face sits 3 mm inside the BentTieBeam x faces

historicalPosterReceipt.purpose: Gallery poster generated from the exact downloadable GLB; separate from authoring feedback.
